say:1:1735803001:1.text: D-Dura above, the wolf looked so sluggish just now! Who knew it could be this vicious!
say:1:1735803001:1.source_cn: 艾、艾雅在上，这只狼看着呆呆的，怎么战斗能力这么强！
say:1:1735803001:1.male: D-Dura above, the wolf looked so sluggish just now! Who knew it could be this vicious!
say:1:1735803001:1.female: D-Dura above, the wolf looked so sluggish just now! Who knew it could be this vicious!

say:2:1735803002:1.text: It's too risky to take it on right now. Let's fall back and call for reinforcements.
say:2:1735803002:1.source_cn: 我们还是先撤退吧。跟它硬打太危险了，再多叫点人来一起驱赶它！
say:2:1735803002:1.male: It's too risky to take it on right now. Let's fall back and call for reinforcements.
say:2:1735803002:1.female: It's too risky to take it on right now. Let's fall back and call for reinforcements.

say:3:1735803003:1.text: Y-You're right. Let's get out of here!
say:3:1735803003:1.source_cn: 好……好，撤退，咱们赶紧撤出山洞！
say:3:1735803003:1.male: Y-You're right. Let's get out of here!
say:3:1735803003:1.female: Y-You're right. Let's get out of here!

narration:4:1735803004:1.text: The guards scramble out of the cave in panic.
narration:4:1735803004:1.male: The guards scramble out of the cave in panic.
narration:4:1735803004:1.female: The guards scramble out of the cave in panic.

narration:5:1735803005:1.text: You apologize to the guards in your mind. Just as you are about to undo your transfiguration...
narration:5:1735803005:1.male: You apologize to the guards in your mind. Just as you are about to undo your transfiguration...
narration:5:1735803005:1.female: You apologize to the guards in your mind. Just as you are about to undo your transfiguration...
